title: Problem
description: An error of the REST API /api/v1 as problem details (RFC 9457, application/problem+json). code is the same code as an MCP tool error.

type.description: https://schemas.dayhand.invalid/problems/<code>: an identifier, not an address to fetch

code.description: invalid_argument, not_found, unauthenticated, insufficient_scope, precondition_failed, conflict, rate_limited, method_not_allowed, unsupported_media_type, payload_too_large, internal (values may be added; treat an unknown code like internal)

retryAfterMs.description: Only with rate_limited: milliseconds until the key may call again
